steps.description: AC-1: Verify fresh install lifecycle checks exist and validate required artifacts plus .its-magic-version creation.
AC-2: Verify overwrite + backup lifecycle checks create backup snapshots for overwritten framework files.
AC-3: Verify upgrade lifecycle checks validate framework refresh and user-data preservation.
AC-4: Verify clean-repo lifecycle checks remove framework artifacts while preserving non-framework marker files.
AC-5: Verify invalid-mode negative-path checks fail fast with deterministic non-zero behavior.
AC-6: Verify both CLI entrypoint (`its-magic`) and direct installer paths are covered in lifecycle tests.
AC-7: Verify lifecycle subset parity exists across PowerShell/shell and CI npm/brew/choco paths.
AC-8: Verify lifecycle tests are isolated/idempotent via temp-directory setup and cleanup.
AC-9: Verify lifecycle QA matrix documentation exists in README and runbook with template parity.
